### Deep learning vs GBM verdict

**XGBoost wins as the single model for H=1 and H=3.** The clean TCN (Bai 2018):
- Marginally beats XGB at H=1 (+0.026 NSE) below the threshold
  of operational relevance.
- Clearly loses at H=3 (-0.0775 NSE, recall@50 drops to 8.7%).

Academic conclusion: with the available inputs (1 rain gauge,
no forecast, 1 basin), GBM and TCN converge to the same information ceiling.
Deep learning would add value with enriched data.
